payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information on how text segmentation is performed and its benefits in processing documents.

claims.text: Text segmentation involves dividing lengthy documents into smaller chunks to improve context encapsulation and processing results.
The segmentation process mimics human reading behavior by allowing the machine to identify and determine the relevance of each chunk.
Models trained on segmented documents show improved accuracy compared to those using whole documents as input.
Different models are created based on the number of chunks, each optimized separately for better performance.
